mission: Execute Phase P0 of BygSmart 3.0 Native: a ground-up rebuild of BygSmart 2.1 as ONE universal Expo application shipping to iOS, Android and an installable PWA from a single codebase. You are the lead engineer. Work autonomously, fan out to sub-agents for parallel work, and stop at the G0 gate for human review.

read_first.instruction: Read these before doing anything. They are the governing specification. Do not re-derive decisions they already contain, and do not contradict them without saying so explicitly.

project.name: BygSmart 3.0 Native

current_phase.name: Decide, spike & scaffold
current_phase.goal: Convert the programme's biggest unknowns into evidence, and stand up a monorepo that builds on three targets with a test harness already in place.

tasks.name: Tri-target sync spike
tasks.detail: Evaluate PowerSync AND ElectricSQL on iOS, Android AND React Native Web against the real schema. PowerSync's RNW support is BETA — that is exactly what this spike must establish. Output: signed decision D-11 (recommendation: BUY, not build).

tasks.name: Calculator divergence measurement
tasks.detail: For each of the ~90 calculators in legacy/modules/tools/pages, determine: does it delegate to catalog.ts, partially delegate, or hold its own maths? StairCalculator.tsx is a known deliberate divergence. Output: a table. This sizes a quarter of the programme.

tasks.name: Schema baseline consolidation
tasks.detail: Collapse 90+ migrations into ONE clean offline-native baseline: soft deletes + tombstones with a retention window, trigger-maintained indexed updated_at on every syncable table, idempotency tables, the cascade-delete design resolved, RLS re-derived. Provision the new Supabase project.

tasks.name: Monorepo + Expo scaffold
tasks.detail: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo. Expo SDK 56 (55 if 56 slips). The universal app must run on web, a PHYSICAL iPhone and a PHYSICAL mid-range Android by day 5.

tasks.name: Test harness
tasks.detail: All eight layers wired. Layers 1, 2 and 7 are REAL. Layers 3, 4, 5, 6, 6b are FAILING PLACEHOLDERS that CI reports as red-pending — a failing placeholder cannot be forgotten, an absent layer can.

tasks.name: Developer accounts
tasks.detail: Apple organisation enrolment needs a D-U-N-S number: 2-4 weeks of pure latency. Google Play too. Reserve com.bygsmart.app on both. THIS IS THE LONGEST LEAD ITEM AND IT IS NOT ENGINEERING WORK.

tasks.name: Repo + identity
tasks.detail: Tag the 2.1 repo v2.1.0-final. Create bygsmart-3-native (private). Vendor the tagged 2.1 tree into legacy/ as ONE snapshot commit. Copy docs/mobile-fork/ into the new repo. Plan domains.

tasks.name: Physical devices
tasks.detail: Buy one current iPhone and one Samsung A54 or equivalent. Needed by day 5. Procurement is latency, not work.

tasks.name: Design key flows
tasks.detail: Capture, check-in, sync states, conflict resolution. P1 must build against something.

subagent_strategy.context_passing: BMAD's core idea: context lives in STORY FILES, not chat history. Before implementing, generate the story with /bmad:story so a fresh agent can pick it up with no prior context. This is how the project survives session boundaries.

non_negotiable: Every PR must produce a GREEN BUILD ON ALL THREE PHYSICAL TARGETS — one real iPhone, one mid-range Android, and web. Simulators do not count. This is the gate teams relax first and it is what prevents a nasty surprise at P7.
NO SKIPPED TESTS, EVER. A skipped test is a lie about what you can safely delete — and being unable to delete things is what turns a fast rebuild into a slow one.

The web performance budget is enforced in CI FROM P1, not measured at P6: first-route JS <= 1.5 MB gzipped, LCP < 2.5s, Lighthouse PWA >= 90. If it drifts, the phone web experience becomes WORSE than 2.1's while still being called an upgrade.
NO SCREEN MAY IMPORT A SYNC-ENGINE TYPE DIRECTLY. Enforce with a lint rule. This is why 'swap the sync engine in a week' is credible.
eslint-plugin-boundaries module discipline is carried into the monorepo on DAY ONE. It is the reason 2.1's code is portable at all.
Module manifest load() uses LITERAL STATIC IMPORT EXPRESSIONS (Metro constraint), and React.lazy is NEVER nested inside React.lazy (caused a production crash on 2026-07-11).
RLS is the SOLE authorisation boundary. The anon key ships inside the binary and is trivially extractable. Never introduce client-side-only authorisation.
MEASURE, DO NOT ESTIMATE SILENTLY. When a number is needed, go and count it. If you must estimate, label it and give the band.
do_not: Do not modify the BygSmart 2.1 repository except to create the tag v2.1.0-final.
Do not carry the 90 incremental migrations forward. One consolidated baseline.
Do not begin P3a/P3b offline work before D-11 is signed.
Do not put any purchase path, module name, price or description into the native binaries (D-13).
Do not skip elicitation on BMAD tasks marked elicit=true, and never answer your own elicitation questions.
Do not build 'compatibility layers' or shims. There are no users to protect. Build the target directly.
Do not treat the browser as a smaller phone — it is a different storage substrate (see 05, section 1).

known_traps: expo-secure-store caps values at ~2048 bytes; Supabase sessions exceed it. A chunking adapter is required.
expo-file-system background upload survives SUSPENSION but not TERMINATION. Resumption after force-quit needs URLSession/WorkManager plus a reconcile-on-launch sweep.
RAM bundles are INCOMPATIBLE with Hermes. Hermes is already the default. Use inline requires instead.
@react-three/fiber does not render under the New Architecture, which Expo SDK 55+ makes mandatory. The 3D wizard stays in apps/admin.
ARKit RoomPlan requires LiDAR — Pro iPhones only. It is a premium path, not the AR strategy.
OPFS is unavailable in Safari private browsing and capped at ~100MB in Chrome incognito. The browser can evict the entire database.
The 1.32 MB regulation corpus and the 239 KB calculator catalogue must never land in the initial bundle.

reporting.cadence: At the end of each task, and at G0.
reporting.format: What was done, what the evidence is, what changed in the plan's assumptions, what is blocked.
escalate_immediately_if: The tri-target sync spike shows PowerSync AND ElectricSQL are both unusable on React Native Web
The universal app cannot be made to run on a physical iPhone or Android by day 7
Any guardrail above would have to be broken to hit a date
